scenes.text: An equation tells a story about equal quantities. Check that the operation and unknown match the story.
Find x in x minus 3 equals 11. The answer is 14. Add 3 to both sides; x equals 14. You can also tell a story that matches the equation.
A volunteer at a market stall had an unknown number x of flyers, gave away 8 and had 16 remaining. Which equation models the story? Pause to choose and explain.

A volunteer at a market stall had an unknown number x of flyers, gave away 8 and had 16 remaining. Which equation models the story? The answer is x minus 8 equals 16. Giving away 8 means subtracting: x minus 8 equals 16.
